scripts.preinstall:
node -e "if(parseInt(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]) < 26) console.warn('
\x1b[33m\x1b[1m⚠️ ATENCIÓN: Se recomienda Node.js v26 o superior para este proyecto.
🔗 Descárgalo aquí: https://nodejs.org/es/download/current
Tu versión es v' + process.versions.node + '\x1b[0m
')"
scripts.postinstall: (python -m pip install -r requirements.txt --quiet --break-system-packages || python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt --quiet --break-system-packages) || echo 'Warning: Python dependencies could not be installed automatically. Please run: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt or python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt'
